summary:
Opened the shared Bug Quest game.
Scrolled the lobby to show Juniper the rabbit, Pebble the fox, their public bio bubbles, and the leaderboard together.
Left the game in the lobby without starting a round.

Opened Bug Quest in recorded replay mode with Live mode left off.
Ran the quest using the default name and instruction and waited for the recorded replay to finish.
Scrolled to the Recorded Kane runs section and left all four result rows visible.
The Basic instruction check passed, the Precise check failed with code 740, and the After fix check passed.

Opened the Airflow DAG named tennis_tournament_pipeline.
Displayed the graph with all six requested tasks visible together: extract, validate, transform, load, standings, and report.
No login was required, and no new run was triggered.
